notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 67481; AKU grapheme O0670 (AKU GR 465). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: O50 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 403, 403B. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1936a. Occurrence: line 12; find place Theben; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 7.2 x 9.1 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Römische Zeit, Antoninische Dynastie, Hadrian, Regierungsjahr 8". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
